'''Jonathan Wilkerson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd–3rd at [[December 2000 Lexington tournament]] on 2 December 2000, according to Matt Baker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1522">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ lexington-ky-12-2-00], DeckTech (Matt "kjerg" Baker, 10 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
Jonathan Wilkerson is credited with the original concept of three Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Set 4]] (released 29 June 2016), [[Virtual Set 7]] (released 13 July 2017) and [[Virtual Set 16]] (released 3 September 2021).

|-
| [[Yoda (V)|•Yoda (V)]] || [[Virtual Set 7]] || 13 July 2017 || "Original concept by Jonathan Wilkerson"
